item.title: World leaders react cautiously to US and Israeli strikes, death of Iran Ali Khamenei
item.description: World leaders have been responding cautiously amid U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran, reports of its supreme leader's death and fears of a wider war. European leaders held emergency meetings and moved to protect citizens in the Middle East. Britain, France, and Germany urged the U.S. and Iran to restart talks. item.title: US and Israel clash with Iran at emergency Security Council meeting. UN chief condemns attacks
item.description: The United States and Israel have clashed with Iran at an emergency meeting of the U.N. Security Council, where the U.N. chief and many countries urged a halt to their attacks and a return to negotiations. Secretary-General António Guterres told the council on Saturday that everything must be done to prevent the conflict from spreading further into the region and beyond.
